policy.market_scope: Las Vegas Valley / Clark County, including Las Vegas, North Las Vegas and Henderson
policy.confirmation_rule: Confirm only when a primary operator/provider/property source explicitly identifies the property as senior apartments, 55+ senior housing, independent senior rental housing, or equivalent non-care senior residential housing. A senior token in a business name is insufficient.
policy.false_positive_rule: Reject an Independent Living classification when a primary source explicitly identifies the business/address as a non-residential service such as adult day care.
policy.unknown_rule: If exact-property primary evidence is insufficient or ambiguous, preserve UNKNOWN.
